commands.note: llama-simple is pure greedy with context auto-sized to prompt+predict — exact parity with the transformers raw reference (do_sample=False). It parses only -m/-n/-ngl; all other flags become part of the prompt (P7 correction after observed arg-echo). stdout = prompt echo + generation; strip the prompt prefix. llama-cli at this pin defaults to chat mode (-st single turn) and applies the Qwen3 thinking template — NOT parity-comparable with a raw reference.

validation_policy.fixtures: 3 synthetic text prompts, frozen before converted output is inspected; 1 near the 4096-token profile limit; expectations + tolerances recorded before evaluation
acceptance: nonempty decoded output for every fixture
clean termination at EOS or the 32-token bound
no runtime errors; no nonfinite values where observable
recorded token/text comparison against the reference; parity metric and threshold declared before conversion
